Installment Payment Plan request

Before you start

  • You’ll be asked security questions, so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your credit card number, registered mobile number, and transaction SMS.
  • Learn more about Installment Payment Plans here.
  • Once you submit, you will receive an SMS with the request details on your registered mobile number and your request will be processed immediately.
  • We’ll get in touch with you within 2 to 3 working days to tell you more about your interest rate.

Start Your Request

Quick Answers

Am I eligible for an Installment Payment Plan?
You can convert purchases worth a minimum of  750 from your latest statement and current billing cycle into Installment Payment Plans.
Can I still earn reward points if I convert a transaction to an Installment Payment Plan with interest?
Yes, you will still earn reward points if you convert your transaction to a regular Installment Payment Plan.
Are there any processing fees for installment plans?
Regular Installment Payment Plan, Balance Conversion, and Loan on Card don’t have a processing fee, but a nominal interest rate applies based on your credit card history and usage. With the 0% interest Installment Payment Plan there could be a one-time processing fee of  51.45 (inclusive of VAT) per transaction. For more details, read more about our fees and charges.
Can I cancel my installment plan?
Yes, you can cancel your installment plan through Mobile Banking and Online Banking. Before cancelling your plan, you will have to settle the remaining principal outstanding plus a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT.
I want to follow up on a previous request.

You can track your previous request by calling us on +971 600 54 0000 and when prompted, say ‘follow up on my request’.
